verdict: Simulation evidence for re-convergence compounding consistent with γ>1. N_reconv_1/N_reconv_2 ratio=1.423 (78% of seeds show Phase 3 faster). Paired t-test p=0.0000. Spearman ρ=-0.8420 (p=0.0000). Each re-convergence episode is faster than the last because the graph is richer → factor noise is lower → same η produces faster centroid tracking. Enrichment rates (P_entity=0.3, P_ioc=0.05) and shift magnitude (δ=0.1) are design choices; real deployments will vary. EXP-G1 with real multi-domain data is the definitive measurement.
verdict_short: RE-CONVERGENCE COMPOUNDING CONFIRMED — simulation evidence consistent with γ>1
